notes: Same app 1.11.7 and chart 0.10.0. The host layer now travels with the update: switch-model.sh, the model profiles, the compose, the nginx proxy config, the container entrypoint and the image build contexts are one signed bundle (host_layer_sha256), laid down by update.sh and converged in place. A box updated from an older install gets the model page, the backup page and remote access wired like a fresh install, its vLLM systemd unit gains the CDI refresh, Gemma stays on its pinned cu130-nightly while the base image is v0.29.0, and the embed gets its 4 GiB KV cap. A box on the previous updater installs the new one at the end of its next apply and is then offered the host layer on its next check.
